changelog: Aura AI v2.1.2 Chat & Sidebar Polish, Gemini Image Flow, Gallery Delete & Pinned Chats
Thinking Accordion Collapsed: Thought processes now stay clean and collapsed by default without auto-expanding
Gemini-Style Image Flow: 'Creating your image' sparkle header, shimmer skeleton preview card, and input locking with Stop button
Images Gallery Auto-Indexing: Instant indexing of all chat-generated images and local folders, plus full Delete support
Sidebar Sub-Agents Cleanup: Clean top-level chat list with no subagent noise or nested badge popups
Context Menu & Pin to Top: Redesigned Porcelain long-press menu with Pin to Top, Rename, Share, Export Markdown, Archive, and Delete
